weapon.d: Effective against armored foes. Grants Res+3. If a bonus granted by a skill like Rally or Hone is active on unit or if unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, neutralizes unit's penalties and inflicts Atk-6 on foe during combat, and foe cannot make a follow-up attack. If foe's Range = 2, calculates damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res.

special.d: Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.
Boosts damage by 50% of unit's Res.

a.d: If foe initiates combat, grants Def+2 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Atk/Def+2 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Atk/Def+4 during combat.
If foe initiates combat, grants Atk/Def+6 during combat and inflicts Special cooldown charge -1 on foe per attack. (Only highest value applied. Does not stack.)

b.d: If unit's HP ≥ 90% and foe initiates combat, grants Special cooldown charge +1 per unit's attack, and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack. (Does not stack.)
If unit's HP ≥ 70% and foe initiates combat, grants Special cooldown charge +1 per unit's attack, and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack. (Does not stack.)
If unit's HP ≥ 50% and foe initiates combat, grants Special cooldown charge +1 per unit's attack, and unit makes a guaranteed follow-up attack. (Does not stack.)

c.d: Grants Atk+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk+3 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk/Spd+4 to dragon allies within 2 spaces during combat.
